title: Cancellation Rollback Stops at the Local State Boundary
title_zh: 取消回滚止于本地状态边界
coreProposition: A local reset can restore the immediate workspace while a real-world effect beyond that boundary remains physically present.
uniqueVisualMetaphor: A pristine workbench restored to an untouched state behind a transparent boundary, while beyond the glass a single stamped parcel has already left on a conveyor and cannot be pulled back.
primarySubject: Clean restored workbench separated by glass from one already-departing physical parcel
composition: Landscape 16:9, clean workbench foreground-left, transparent boundary crossing frame, departing parcel in background-right; visual tension comes from irreversible spatial separation.
palette: Neutral slate, soft cool daylight, clear glass highlights, restrained red-orange accent on the departing parcel seal without lettering
style: Serious editorial technology still-life photography, physically credible, cinematic depth, strong semantic contrast, low information density
